name: Vantage Data Centres KUL1 campus, Cyberjaya
status_detail: Operational · four buildings (KUL11–KUL14) fully operational; KUL14 launched December 2025
summary: Vantage Data Centers' first Malaysian campus (KUL1) in Cyberjaya comprises four multi-storey data centre buildings delivering 31 MW of critical IT load across a 6-acre (2-hectare) site. The campus is carrier-neutral with Uptime Institute Tier III certifications and hosts Equinix KL1 as a tenant. The fourth building KUL14 (16 MW) was completed in December 2025, fully leased to a single customer. A second 52-acre campus (KUL2) offering 400+ MW is under development nearby.

scale.label: Campus capacity
scale.value: 31 MW critical IT load, 463,000 sq ft

why_it_matters: Vantage's fully operational KUL1 campus is one of the anchor hyperscale facilities in Cyberjaya, hosting major tenants including Equinix. The rapid follow-on with a 52-acre KUL2 campus signals that Cyberjaya is becoming Southeast Asia's densest data-centre corridor outside Singapore.
